meta.description: Territories, destinations, verified businesses, culture and music from Nicaragua.
lang.label: Language
lang.ui_review: This interface translation is pending review by a native speaker.
footer.emergency: In danger right now? Call {118} (Police), {115} (Fire department) or {128} (Red Cross).
cookies.title: Your browser, your rules
cookies.body: We store what the site needs to work. If you agree, we also count which pages are visited, without your name, email or IP.
cookies.measure_desc: Optional. It helps us see which parts are used. Deleted after 90 days.
cookies.gpc: Your browser asks not to be tracked (Global Privacy Control), so this stays off.
legal.spanish_only: For now this text is only available in Spanish.
home.title: Nicaragua, contour by contour
home.intro: Explore the country's 17 territories by their terrain: volcanoes, lagoons, communities and the people who welcome you in each one.
home.search_placeholder: A volcano, a town, a dish…
home.sources: Every listing shows its source and the date it was checked.
home.error: The territory catalog couldn't load. Reload the page to try again.
home.empty: Territories are published as the editorial team verifies their sources. Check back soon.
discover.intro: Choose a territory or search for a volcano, a town or a dish. Every listing shows its source and the date it was checked.
error.not_configured: This section turns on once the services are connected. Not available yet.
error.permission: You don't have permission for this. Sign in with the right account.
error.limit: You've reached today's limit for new messages. Try again tomorrow.
error.not_found: We couldn't find what you're looking for. It may no longer be published.
error.database: The database returned an error. Try again in a moment.
error.network: No connection, or the service didn't respond. Check your internet and try again.
adventure.title: Plan your trip without guessing
adventure.intro: Routes come from a map provider and every price carries its date. When something isn't confirmed, the plan tells you.
planner.label: Tell me about your trip
planner.hint: Use your own words: how many of you, how many days, your budget and what you enjoy.
planner.example: We're going for five days, there are four of us, we have 600 dollars and we want beaches, good food and to meet small businesses.
planner.languages_note: For now I understand trips written in Spanish or English.
planner.accessibility_note: I'll only suggest places with verified accessibility.
planner.missing_title: To build real routes I still need to know
planner.promise: I only use verified prices. Anything without a confirmed price will show as "quote needed", and transfers are calculated with a map provider.
question.days: How many days is the trip?
question.budget_currency: Is your budget in dollars or córdobas?
question.transport: Will you have a vehicle or use public transport?
community.title: Behind every trip there's someone with a name
community.intro: The Our People showcase gives free visibility to eateries, guides, artisans and farms across the country. Write to them directly, with no middlemen or commissions.
community.order_note: In chronological order. We don't rank by engagement or sell positions.
community.empty: No stories published yet. Share the first one from your profile.
hours.none: Not confirmed. Check before you go.
business.no_contacts: This business hasn't published any contact details yet.
business.sign_in_to_write: Sign in to write through the platform.
business.no_e2e: Messages are not end-to-end encrypted. Don't share banking details.
business.messaging_off: Platform messaging turns on once sign-in is set up. Not available yet.
business.no_prices: No prices published. Write to them for a quote.
territory.no_content: There's no editorial content published for this territory in your language yet.
search.empty: We found no published listings for that. Try another word or explore a territory.
messages.title: Messages
messages.empty_inbox: You don't have any conversations yet. Write to a business from its listing.
messages.empty_thread: There are no messages in this conversation yet.
messages.off: Messaging turns on once sign-in is set up. Not available yet.
messages.sign_in: Sign in to see your messages.
legal.load_error: The texts couldn't load. Close and reopen the app.
community.publish_unavailable: Business registration isn't available on Android yet. Not available yet.
profile.resent: We sent the verification email again.
auth.title: Your account
auth.intro: Sign in to save favorites and itineraries, write to businesses and share your stories.
auth.not_configured: Sign-in turns on once the Firebase project is connected. Not available yet.
auth.name: Your name
auth.terms_note: By continuing you accept the terms and the privacy policy (under legal review).
auth.created: Account created. We sent you an email to verify your address.
auth.reset_sent: If an account exists with that email, you'll get a link to change your password.
auth.have_account: I already have an account: sign in
auth.err.invalid_credential: The email or password doesn't match.
auth.err.user_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
auth.err.email_in_use: An account with that email already exists. Sign in or reset your password.
auth.err.weak_password: The password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.err.too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.err.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
auth.err.popup_closed: You closed the Google window before finishing.
auth.err.blocked: This account is suspended. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
auth.err.profile_failed: You're signed in, but we couldn't set up your profile. Try again in a moment.
report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: Pollution, harm to wildlife, trail hazards, harassment or misleading information.
report.emergency_title: Is there an emergency right now?
report.emergency_body: This platform doesn't alert the authorities for you. Call right away:
report.off: Report submission turns on once sign-in is set up. Not available yet.
report.follow: You can follow its status in your profile. We'll let you know when it changes.
report.what: What do you want to report?
report.privacy: Your report is confidential and is never published. It's only forwarded to an institution with your consent and through an official channel; if that happens, you'll see the acknowledgment in the follow-up.
register.title: List your business for free
register.intro: Your business appears on the map once the team reviews the details. We don't charge commissions or listing fees.
register.off: Registration turns on once sign-in is connected. Not available yet.
register.sign_in: Sign in to register your business.
register.failed: Couldn't send it. Check the details and try again.
register.offline: No connection. Your details are still in the form; try again.
register.sent_note: We'll let you know when it's published. You can follow its status in your profile.
register.name: Business name
map.error: The search couldn't complete. Try again.
map.empty_query: We found no published places with that name. Try another word or the name of the municipality.
map.empty: No places published yet. The catalog grows as sources are verified.
map.order_note: Order: relevance; among equally relevant results the order rotates daily. Nobody pays to appear here.
map.off: The interactive map turns on once the map provider is connected.
map.off_note: In the meantime, use the search: the results are the same.
map.ready: {n} places published on the map. Protected locations are shown approximately or not at all.
map.error_load: The map couldn't load. Search is still available.
culture.title: History, art and culture
culture.intro: Every piece cites its sources. Topics with different interpretations are presented with their perspectives, and community knowledge is published with consent.
culture.timeline_empty: The timeline is published as the editorial team reviews the sources.
culture.contested: This has differing interpretations: the entry presents the perspectives.

relief.aria_touch: 3D relief of the two volcanoes of Ometepe Island. Swipe to rotate it and tap a summit to see its name.
relief.aria_static: Contour lines of the two volcanoes of Ometepe Island

destination.meta_desc: {name}, in Nicaragua. Listing with source, check date, and verified hours and prices.
business.meta_desc: {name}, a local business in Nicaragua. Direct contact, no middlemen or commissions.

tmap.hint: Hover over or tap a territory to see its name.
gallery.title: All 17, one by one
gallery.intro: Each cover is drawn from the real shape of its territory. They are illustrations, not photos: photos will come once they are verified.
gallery.label: Parade of covers of the 17 territories

relief.territory_static: Illustrated cover of {name}, built from its real shape
relief.territory_note: Real shape; heights are illustrative, not topography.
